content.short: Airfoil is a full-stack Web3 design agency that blends cryptocurrency expertise with aesthetically pleasing interfaces to support product success.
content.description: Airfoil, founded in 2019, is a holistic Web3 design agency that blends cryptocurrency expertise with visually refined interfaces. The studio has partnered with more than 100 ventures and propelled more than 90 products into public view, spanning Web3 projects and fintech initiatives. Its collaborations include Solana, Ava Labs, and Hyperspace, reflecting sustained engagement with major players across the Web3 and fintech spaces. This track record emphasizes Airfoil's focus on merging crypto know-how with design to deliver clear, accessible experiences.
